question: Which Indian city was announced by the global governing body WPA as the host of the 2025 Para Athletics World Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 Para Athletics World Championships** will be hosted by **New Delhi**, India. This marks the first time India will host this prestigious international event.
 
• The announcement was made by the **World Para Athletics (WPA)**, the global governing body for para-athletics, highlighting India’s growing focus on promoting sports for differently-abled athletes.
 
• India has previously hosted significant para-sporting events, including the **Commonwealth Games** and the **Asian Para Games**, which reflects its capability in organizing global tournaments. *Hence, New Delhi is the correct location for hosting the event.*
 
• **New Delhi**, the capital city of India, is well-equipped with world-class facilities, infrastructure, and accessibility standards required for hosting such a major international para-athletics event.
 
• The event is expected to attract athletes from all over the world, promoting ** in sports and showcasing India's organizational capabilities. *Hence, New Delhi is a strategic choice for the venue.*
 
• India’s hosting of the Para Athletics World Championships** aligns with its commitment to empowering differently-abled individuals and fostering a culture of equality in sports. **Para-sports** have gained significant attention in India over the past decade. *Hence, the announcement is a milestone in India’s sporting history.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About World Para Athletics:**

 
 
• **World Para Athletics (WPA)** is the governing body for para-athletics worldwide. It is a part of the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**, which oversees various para-sporting events globally.
 
• WPA organizes several international events, including **World Championships**, which provide a platform for athletes with disabilities to showcase their talents and compete at the highest level.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi as a Sporting Hub:**
 
 
• **New Delhi** is known for hosting several international sporting events, such as the **2010 Commonwealth Games**, showcasing its infrastructure and organizational capabilities.
 
• The city is equipped with facilities like the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** and **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium**, which are among the largest and most advanced stadiums in India.
 
• The city is well-connected internationally and domestically, making it a convenient location for athletes and officials traveling from across the globe.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Para Athletics World Championships:**
 
 
• The **Para Athletics World Championships** serves as a platform for promoting inclusivity and accessibility in sports, encouraging the participation of differently-abled athletes.
 
• The event helps in breaking societal barriers and stereotypes associated with disability, fostering a spirit of equality and empowerment.
 
• It also highlights the importance of infrastructure development and policy-making to support para-athletes in their training and competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India’s Achievements in Para Sports:**

 
 
• India has shown remarkable progress in **para-sports** over the years, with athletes winning accolades in events such as the **Paralympic Games**, **Asian Para Games**, and various international championships.
 
• Prominent Indian para-athletes like **Devendra Jhajharia** (javelin throw) and **Deepa Malik** (shot put) have won medals in global events, inspiring many across the nation.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Para Sports:**
 
 
• The Indian government has introduced several schemes to support para-athletes, including the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** and **Para Sports Development Fund**.
 
• The **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** plays a crucial role in providing training facilities, coaching, and financial assistance to para-athletes.
 
• India’s hosting of the 2025 Para Athletics World Championships is an important step in furthering its commitment to promoting para-sports on the global stage.
